title: Enabling Intelligent Connectivity: A Survey of Secure ISAC in 6G Networks
domain: Secure ISAC (integrated sensing and communication) in 6G networks

analysis_policy.exclude_scope: References, author bios/photos, acknowledgments, appendix, nomenclature
analysis_policy.notes: Span tags retained; mixed HTML/markdown tables kept.

section_flow.objective: Motivate secure ISAC for 6G intelligent connectivity, outline scope, and structure.
key_components: ISAC context and need for security
notable_moves: Sets security as equal priority with sensing/communication in ISAC intro

evidence_locators.claim: Frames secure ISAC gap and states scope/organization for 6G intelligent connectivity.

section_flow.objective: Describe unified ISAC IoT architecture, evaluation indexes, and platform components.
notable_moves: Introduces performance evaluation indexes early to anchor later layers

evidence_locators.claim: Details unified architecture, performance indexes, and platforms for ISAC.

section_flow.objective: List future directions and challenges for secure ISAC across timing, security, AI, resource management, and robustness.

section_flow.objective: Summarize secure ISAC survey and reiterate challenges.
key_components: Recap of layer-wise ISAC and security
notable_moves: Brief close pointing back to future work

evidence_locators.claim: Concludes by summarizing secure ISAC layers and future directions.

hook.evidence: Introduces intelligent connectivity vision and secure ISAC role in 6G.

gap.evidence: Notes limited surveys combining ISAC architecture with security across layers.

yes_but.evidence: Acknowledges existing ISAC work but stresses missing layer-wise secure perspective.

contribution.evidence: States contributions: unified architecture, layer-wise secure ISAC discussion, metrics, and future directions.

scope_boundary.evidence: Focus on secure ISAC across hardware, omniscient, and application layers with metrics and platforms.

rhetorical_moves_global.reader_contract_pattern: Motivate secure ISAC; present unified architecture with metrics/platform; cover hardware/omniscient/application layers including security; list future challenges; conclude.

branches: Hardware layer: preliminaries, unified waveform, security
Omniscient layer: ISAC architecture, software-defined communication, security
Application layer: AI-empowered networks, multimodal connectivity, security, scenarios

visuals_tables.layout_logic: Figures/tables support architecture, layer breakdown, and performance indexes; each layer section includes illustrative figures; future directions are text-heavy.

figures.purpose: show unified ISAC IoT architecture and layer relationships

tables.purpose: summarize performance evaluation indexes and platform components

lesson_blocks.lesson: Early definition of performance indexes guides later layer discussions.
Unified waveforms must balance sensing and communication while embedding security.
Software-defined communication plus AI enables adaptive ISAC but adds security exposure.
AI and multimodal connectivity expand use cases; security must be revisited at application level.
Key gaps revolve around synchronization, trustworthy AI, privacy, resource management, and robustness.

synthesis.aha_moment: Layering secure ISAC across hardware, omniscient, and application tiers with shared performance indexes keeps sensing-communication-security trade-offs aligned.

style.section_openers_pattern: Introduce layer/topic, then enumerate components and security aspects with figures/tables.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Layered secure ISAC roadmap
steps: Present unified ISAC architecture with performance indexes and platform elements.
Organize subsequent sections by layers (hardware, omniscient, application), each with security coverage.
Use figures/tables to anchor the roadmap.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Gives readers a scaffold to follow complex multi-layer ISAC content with security built in.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Layer sections with embedded security
steps: For each layer, outline core ISAC functions (waveform/SDC/AI, etc.).
Include a dedicated security subsection within the layer.
Close with key trade-offs or takeaways.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Maintains consistent security emphasis while covering technical content.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Application layer synthesis
steps: Add multimodal connectivity and application-layer security.
Follow with scenario examples to illustrate applicability.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Links technical enablers to concrete scenarios, reinforcing security needs at the edge.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Future directions tied to layers
steps: List challenges that map back to each layer (timing, AI trust, privacy, resource/protocols, robustness).
Use them to signal research agenda.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Connects earlier layer discussions to a clear future research map.

notes: Counts heuristic; figures/tables spread across layers; future section text-heavy.
